question: Who can protect the practitioner when Śiva or the guru becomes angered?
premises: If Śiva is angered, the guru can protect.
If the guru is angered, no one can protect.
The guru's role is uniquely decisive.
inference: The guru protects when Śiva is angered, but no one protects when the guru is angered.
plain_english: When Śivā is angered, the guru is the protector; but when the guru is angered, there is no one at all.
